items.text: Main slate news locked; Malik Nabers (knee) murky for SNF, up to him. Giants elevated Braxton Berrios and Dalen Cambre.
items.why: Knee; full practice but decision pending; elevations signal contingency
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out/limited, targets elsewhere

items.text: Weekend reports summary: Love & Odunze expected; Kamara not expected; Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful); Nabers no news yet.
items.implication: Lock lineups around confirmed expected/not; monitor Nabers SNF
items.opportunity: Role clarity for backups on outs

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play vs Chargers.
items.why: Ankle sprain; progressing, coach optimistic, sources confirm
items.implication: RB1 upside even if managed; Allgeier goal-line
items.opportunity: Carries + routes as explosive lead back

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) is not expected to play vs Lions despite full Friday participation; not quite ready.
items.why: MCL sprain; full participant late week but sources say not ready
items.implication: Sit Kamara; NO backfield volume opens
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for Etienne and committee

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) expected to play vs Panthers; source confirms will go.
items.why: Limited all week but self-reported ready; Rapoport source
items.implication: Start with slight risk on snap share; monitor inactives
items.opportunity: Full routes if active; Burden/others secondary

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (ankle) off injury report, cleared/full practices, will play vs Dolphins; feels really good.
items.why: Full week practices after camp ankle sprain; self-reported good
items.implication: Start as RB2/low RB1; possible light management
items.opportunity: Three-down workhorse + Bowers absence boosts targets

items.text: Snaps/pace: NO@DET up in pace; MIA@LV slow slog; CHI@CAR total nudged up 2-3 pts to 47.5. Updated for Tua/Bowers.
items.implication: Volume edge NO-DET skill players; fade MIA-LV pace
items.opportunity: Higher play volume for Lions/Saints pass catchers/RBs

items.text: CMC usage concerns overblown (preseason bang-up, long flight, weird game); contrarian BUY LOW; not worried.
items.why: Context of limited preseason/usage not indicative
items.implication: Hold/start confidently; buy if panicked owners sell
items.conflict: Recent usage optics vs long-term profile

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers ruled out (meniscus trim); expected miss 1-2 weeks. Mayer extension and expanded role.
items.why: Meniscus procedure midweek; coach confirmed out
items.opportunity: Mayer targets/routes spike; Jeanty more involved

items.text: Isaiah Likely strong TE play; ranks high PPG/target; Nabers won't be 100%; Giants WR2 is Fields or Mooney. Gimme all the Likely.
items.why: 4th in TE FPP target last 3 yrs; 6+ targets = 12.5+ PPR often; Nabers limited
items.implication: Start Likely; especially if Nabers inactive/limited
items.opportunity: Target share spike with Nabers uncertainty

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr unlikely to play vs Falcons (back) amid contract/trade murk; possibility of in-season trade.
items.implication: Secondary weaker; possible WR boost for ATL

items.text: Maxx Crosby will play for Raiders; shut down trade talks post-Ravens nixed deal, told teams including Rams he stays.
items.implication: Raiders DL strength intact; minor fantasy (IDP)

items.text: Chuba Hubbard viable flex this week; keeping it open on The Chubbler amid committee.
Saquon Barkley vs WAS: 136.5 rush yds / 6.0 YPC / 21+ PPR in 4 prior meetings (incl playoffs); WAS front still below avg.
Chris Olave with Tyler Shough: 29% target share, 14.7+ PPR in 75% games last year; Lions safeties on IR; high O/U game.
items.opportunity: Target share + volume in up-tempo spot

items.text: Parker Washington: 24% target share when 70%+ routes; 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share; Ward primarily on BTJ vs CLE.
items.implication: Strong WR3/flex; contract hold irrelevant short-term

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr expected; when MHJ 50%+ snaps Wilson 5.5 PPG/13% share; off-field Wilson 28% share. Wilson down with MHJ in.
items.implication: Start MHJ; fade Wilson if both active
items.opportunity: MHJ primary; Wilson only if MHJ limited

items.text: Justin Herbert FPP A 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year; Alt healthy; Cards DL/secondary weak (PFF 31/26, pressure 27th).
